title: Drunken Cloth

sources.title: Snowy Liver
markers: | description = While {{Cond|Drunk}} you have {{Advantage}} on [[Constitution]] {{Saving Throw}}s, and you gain [[Temporary Hit Points]] equal to your [[Constitution]] Modifier at the start of your turn.

summary: Unarmoured clothing with base AC 10 plus Dexterity modifier. While Drunk, gain advantage on Constitution saves and temporary HP equal to your Constitution modifier at the start of your turn.

fields.Drunk: The linked condition imposes disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks.
fields.Base value: 800 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Snowy Liver: While affected by Drunk, Alcohol, or Drunk (Drunken Master), gain advantage on Constitution saves and gain temporary HP equal to your Constitution modifier at the start of your turn.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
